games.name: The Intruder
games.desc:
You are alone in your house. Suddenly, the phone rings. The police department issues a warning that a criminal is on the loose. Unfortunately, the criminal has a new target: YOU. Updates: Fixed lever bug in hospital chapter.

Controls:
Flashlight: [PC: F, Gamepad: Y]
Sprint (For Mineshaft): [PC: Left-Shift, Gamepad: B]
Skill-Checks: [PC: E, Gamepad: A] 
Objective: [PC: Q]

games.name: Stand Power
games.desc:
"Stand Power" is largely inspired by the series "JoJo's Bizarre Adventure".

COMMANDS:
!rejoin -> Allows you to rejoin the same server in-game.
!pity -> Displays your current shiny stand chance pity percentage.
!trade (player name) -> Sends a STAND trade request to the specified player.
!confirm (player name) -> Confirms the TRADE REQUEST that you've sent.
!accept (player name) -> Both parties must enter this command to finalize the trade (this comes after the "!confirm" command).
!giveitem (player name) -> Gives the targeted player the item you're currently holding.

🌐Available on:

・💻 PC
・📱 MOBILE
・🎮 CONSOLE (Note: A keyboard and mouse are required for gameplay)

💻PC Controls:
・F to BLOCK
・L to open INVENTORY
・CTRL to RUN

games.name: Saber Legends
games.desc:
Engage in epic saber battles in several unique game modes!

📝DUELING GUIDE📝
https://devforum.roblox.com/t/-/2287354

💻CONTROLS🎮
One/ButtonX - Equip | Q/DPadUp - Ignite 
M1/R1 - Attack | M2/L1 - Block 
E/ButtonB - Slap | C/DPadDown - Saber Throw 
X/DPadRight - Swap Force | F/R2 - Use Force 
L/ButtonY - Mouse Lock | B/DPadLeft - Duel 

💨 Gain power focus by looking at enemies until you see smoke to use powers. 

🕹️COMBOS🕹️ 
Block + Attack: Disarm 
Block: Grab Saber/Ignite 
Jump + Attack: Special Attack 
Jump + Crouch: Roll 
Attack + Ignite/Equip: Feint
